Meta Loses Bid on US Claims Over Children's Addiction to Social Media

A US court has rejected Meta's attempt to dismiss a lawsuit alleging that its social media platforms, including Facebook and Instagram, are addictive to children. The lawsuit claims that the platforms' design and algorithms contribute to addiction in minors. This ruling may have implications for online content regulation and child protection policies.
